description:
Designs, builds, and deploys robotic process automation solutions by translating business requirements into scalable automated workflows, ensuring high‑quality, reliable bots that improve efficiency across Netsmart’s processes and teams. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, configure, and test solutions to automate processes, activities, and tasks using robotic process automation (RPA).

 Gather process requirements from key stakeholders, assess automation feasibility, and identify automation opportunities.

 Provide technical direction on design considerations, including performance, scalability, availability, and maintainability.

 Deploy robotic process automation software and components, such as bots, orchestrators, development tools, and integrations.

 Anticipate, identify, track, and resolve technical issues.

 Perform quality checks, code review, and testing in development and production environments.

 Collaborate on cross-functional teams to deliver projects by assigned deadlines.
 

 
 Qualifications 
 Required
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or relevant certifications in RPA technologies

 At least 1 year UiPath or another RPA tool or software engineering work experience

 Basic programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or C#

 Demonstrated Microsoft and VBA skills

 Familiarity with database concepts and SQL

 Understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

 Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies

 Understanding of process analysis and optimization techniques

 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

 Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

 Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams

 Attention to detail and commitment to quality

 
 Preferred
 Proficiency in at least one RPA tool (e.g., UiPath, Blue Prism, Automation Anywhere)

 UiPath Certified Professional Automation Developer Associate Certification. 

 Internships or projects demonstrating RPA implementation

 Knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on RPA implementations
